description: Add and update tests covering ReadDisposition serialization and the Message/set default-injection behavior.
design:
In crate-jmap-chat-types/src/message.rs — update existing test + add new:

1. Update delivery_receipt_roundtrip (existing):
   Add readDisposition field to the hand-crafted JSON fixture:
   { "deliveredAt": "...", "readAt": "...", "readDisposition": "displayed" }
   Assert dr.read_disposition == Some(ReadDisposition::Displayed).
   Re-serialize and assert round-trip fidelity.

2. New test read_disposition_roundtrip:
   Test all three named values ("displayed", "deleted", "processed") deserialize to
   their variants and re-serialize to the same string.
   Test an unknown value "voice-listened" deserializes to Other("voice-listened")
   and re-serializes to "voice-listened" — not rejected, not mangled.

In crate-jmap-chat-server (integration tests — follow the existing test harness pattern):

3. New test message_set_read_at_defaults_disposition:
   Create a message in MemoryBackend. Call Message/set update with { readAt: <now> } only.
   Assert the stored message has readDisposition == "displayed".

4. New test message_set_explicit_disposition:
   Same but patch includes { readAt: <now>, readDisposition: "deleted" }.
   Assert stored message has readDisposition == "deleted".

5. New test message_set_extension_disposition:
   Patch includes { readAt: <now>, readDisposition: "voice-listened" }.
   Assert stored message has readDisposition == "voice-listened" (stored as-is).

6. New test message_set_no_read_at_no_disposition:
   Patch does not include readAt. Assert readDisposition is NOT injected
   (stored message readDisposition remains None).
title: chat: tests for ReadDisposition roundtrip and Message/set defaults
